requirements.title: Machine-Readable Requirements Source of Truth
requirements.description: Maintain persistent machine-readable requirement store and validator tracking lifecycle, dependencies, verification status, and release gates.

requirements.title: VOXY Autonomous Coding Harness
requirements.description: Controlled development harness supporting repository indexing, semantic symbol search, AST/patch generation, sandboxed command execution, emergency stop, and rollback.

requirements.title: Commercial Identity, Authentication & Session Security
requirements.description: Production authentication engine using Argon2id password hashing, cryptographic session tokens (minimum 128-bit entropy), expiration, revocation, rate-limiting, and brute-force protection.

requirements.title: Dodo Payments Hosted Checkout & Client Integration
requirements.description: Integration with official Dodo Payments API for hosted subscription checkout, multi-tier product plans, currencies (USD, INR, EUR), and localized billing intervals.

requirements.title: Webhook Security, Signature Verification & Idempotency
requirements.description: Secure Dodo Payments webhook handler with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, replay protection (timestamp checking), unique event ID tracking, and transactional idempotency.

requirements.title: Subscription State Machine & Entitlements Engine
requirements.description: Explicit subscription lifecycle state machine (Pending, Active, PastDue, Cancelled, Expired, Refunded, PaymentFailed, Suspended). Server-side entitlement resolution; client cannot forge plan privileges.

requirements.title: Production Relational Database & Encrypted Backup
requirements.description: Relational SQLite/database schemas with migrations: users, sessions, subscriptions, payment_customers, entitlements, webhook_events, audit_events, consents. Encrypted backups and tested restoration.

requirements.title: Commercial Web & Server-Side API Architecture
requirements.description: Server-side RESTful API groups (/auth, /billing, /subscriptions, /checkout, /entitlements, /consent, /health) with request validation, authentication middleware, rate limiting, and structured errors.

requirements.title: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service & Versioned Consent
requirements.description: Production privacy policy and terms reflecting actual data flows (AI providers, telemetry, payments). Versioned clickwrap consent tracking and cookie preferences.

requirements.title: 24/7 Continuous Low-Latency Voice Pipeline
requirements.description: Continuous listening voice pipeline with acoustic echo cancellation, dereverberation, multilingual STT/TTS (Hindi, Hinglish, English), sub-50ms intent preprocessing, and seamless barge-in.

requirements.title: Windows Computer Control & Dedicated VOXY Cursor Indicator
requirements.description: Semantic UI Automation & Win32 action engine with visible on-screen VOXY interaction cursor/indicator, permission scopes, destructive-action confirmation policies, and global emergency stop.

requirements.title: Enterprise Office Automation Connectors
requirements.description: Extensible connectors for email, calendar, documents, spreadsheets, filesystem, and browser with granular permission scopes, audit logging, and cancellation.

requirements.title: Smart Context-Aware VOXY Overlay & Premium UX
requirements.description: Intelligent HUD overlay that repositions around active user windows, snaps to edges, automatically evades/minimizes during fullscreen video/gaming, and surfaces voice, thinking, and control states.

requirements.title: Production Packaging, Installer & Automated Recovery
requirements.description: Automated WiX MSI and MSIX build pipelines with dynamic SDK discovery, clean upgrade/uninstall verification, daemon watchdog auto-restart, and zero personal machine dependencies.
